features.title: Monster hunter
features.text: Slayers study dangerous creatures and prepare special hunting tools. Ten minutes of research lets them mark a creature of their level or higher as quarry.

features.title: Claim trophies
features.text: Defeat that quarry and take a trophy to strengthen your tools for the next hunt. Preparation gives a slayer an edge against a chosen foe.
